package.desc: Provides robot boards, state wiring, simulation, and checking.
package.title: Table robots

ui.1. 两条路线停在<b>同一格</b>：在计数器眼里，它们是同一个状态。: 1. Both routes stop on the same cell: to the counter, they are the same state.
ui.2. 一条<b>拿了钥匙</b>，一条<b>没拿</b>。: 2. One has picked up the key, the other has not.
ui.2. 每个字最多连<b>一根</b>线: 2. Each letter takes at most one line
ui.3. 从这一格往右或往下一步，<b>就是门</b>：它们的未来不同。: 3. One step right or down from that cell is a door: their futures differ.
ui.= 所有指向它的地点的路线数之和: = the sum of the routes to every place that points to it
ui.{a} + {b} = <b>{a2}</b>，不等于当前格子的 <b>{cur: {a} + {b} = {a2}, which isn’t the current cell’s {cur}. The seam didn’t come from here.
ui.{n} 件物品，每件都有带和不带两种选择，一共 <b>{value}</b> 种: {n} items, each either taken or left behind: {value} packings in all. Every extra item doubles the number of packings.
ui.{test}、{want}、{got} 换成失败的测试: {test}, {want}, {got} filled in from the failed test
ui.{value}的价值是 <b>{value2}</b>，可旁边还有 <b>{va: {value} has a value of {value2}, but there is a neighbour worth {value3}. That cell is closer to the treasure.
ui.{value}：<b>「{name}」</b>。{desc}图里蓝框是它的视野（: {value}: {name}. {desc} In the picture, the blue frames are its view ({n}×{n}) and the red frame is the cell it stands on.
ui.{value}：填一个数（不填 = 清空这一格）: {value}: type a number (leave blank to clear the cell)
ui.{value}：机器在<b>{value2}</b>出了错。「{value3}」: {value}: the machine went wrong at {value2}. “{value3}” should be {value4}, but your circuit computed {value5}. The board has stopped on this cell; the small numbers on the circuit board are the values the machine computed here.
ui.{value}：答案应该是 <b>{value2}</b>，机器算出了 <b>{: {value}: the answer should be {value2}, but the machine computed {value3}. {value4}
ui.{value}：表稳定下来以后，<b>{value2}</b>应该是 <b>{v: {value}: once the table settles, {value2} should be {value3}, but your circuit board computed {value4}. It is the cell marked in red on the board.
ui.「{value}」和「{value2}」不一样，不能连: “{value}” and “{value2}” are different, so they can’t be linked
ui.「是 / 否」信号只能接到闸门的条件口、「任一是」或「取反」。: A “yes / no” signal can only go into a gate’s condition input, “any yes” or “Not”.
ui.「是」变「否」，「否」变「是」。收到「—」时，输出「—」。: “Yes” becomes “no” and “no” becomes “yes”. A “—” comes out as “—”.
ui.「最划算」指每千克的价值最高。: “Best value” means the highest value per kilogram.
ui.「颜色」这类信号只能接进闸门的数口。: A kind (a colour, say) can only go into a gate’s value input.
ui.一个想法在元件箱里借用哪一关的电路板: the level whose board an idea borrows in the components box
ui.一个格子只能存一个数。它记住了更大的 {value}（历史 A），就忘掉了历史: A cell can hold only one number. Once it remembers the larger {value} (history A), history B is forgotten. Yet at house 3, the best total, {value2}, comes precisely from B. For the machine to tell history A from B, the cell has to remember one more fact: whether this house was robbed.
ui.一堆石子：一次拿一颗或两颗，拿走最后一颗的赢: a pile of stones: take one or two, whoever takes the last wins
ui.一小块示意电路：上面是输入，中间是元件，下面是输出: a little circuit: inputs on top, parts in rows, outputs at the bottom
ui.一张图：每格的能量，找一条最不起眼的缝: a picture: each cell’s energy, the least noticeable seam
ui.一张画好的图：格子、箭头和字，坐标照写: a picture as drawn: cells, arrows and words, at their coordinates
ui.一排房子，每家一个格子: a row of houses, one cell a house
ui.一排房子，每家三个格子：没偷、偷了、最多: a row of houses, three cells a house: skipped, robbed, most so far
ui.一排房子，每格是到这一家为止的总数: a row of houses, each cell the total so far
ui.一整段只能接进汇合器、加法器或乘法器。: A whole segment can only go into a Merger, an Adder or a Multiplier.
ui.一条条剪掉图里的缝: cutting seams out of a picture one by one
ui.一条条找出所有路线: tracing every route one by one
ui.一步步的引导：显示第一条 until 还不成立的: step-by-step guidance: the first whose until does not hold yet
ui.一段楼梯：一次上一级或两级，坏台阶踩不得: a flight of stairs: one or two steps at a time, broken steps not to be stood on
ui.一直输出同一个数。放上电路板后，点它可以改数值。: Always outputs the same number. Once it is on the board, click it to change the number.
ui.一直退到了顶行：这就是能量最小的那条缝。: Traced all the way back to the top row: this is the lowest-energy seam.
ui.一种元件直接接进另一种元件: a part of one type wired straight into a part of another
ui.三个起点都走到了宝藏。: All three starts reached the treasure.
ui.上面是图片，下面是缝表：每格是「从顶行到这里，最省的缝要花多少能量」。正在看的格: The picture is on top and the seam table below: each cell is “the least energy a seam from the top row to here can cost”. The cell you are looking at shows that pixel’s own energy in its corner. Start by clicking the smallest cell in the bottom row.
ui.不能偷 3 号：它和 2 号相邻: Can’t rob #3: it is next to #2
ui.两堆石子：(a, b) 是两堆各剩几颗，存轮到的人能不能赢: two piles of stones: (a, b) the stones left, holding whether the player to move wins
ui.两条路线{both}钥匙。它们不光状态相同，未来也一样，这不算破绽。让一条拿钥匙: {both} the key. They share not only a state but also a future, so this is no flaw. Let one take the key and the other not.
ui.两条路线停在不同的格子：A 在{a}，B 在{b}。计数器当然分得清不同的格子，: The routes stop on different cells: A at {a}, B at {b}. Of course the counter can tell different cells apart. Make them stop on the same cell.
ui.两种常见的捷径：按某种顺序挨个看，装得下就装。: Two popular shortcuts: go through the items in some order and pack each one that still fits.
ui.亲手填表：每个地点的路线数: filling the table by hand: the routes to every place
ui.从上一个任务的电路板开始: start from the task before’s board
ui.从右下角倒推：走对角线是保留或替换，往上是删除，往左是插入。: Walking back from the bottom-right corner: a diagonal step is a keep or a replace, a step up is a delete, and a step left is an insert.
ui.从右下角沿绿色格子倒推，每走一次对角线，就是一根连线。公共子序列：{common: Walk back from the bottom-right corner along the green cells: every diagonal step is one line. Common subsequence: {common}
ui.从最大的那一格倒推，一直退到 0 为止。: Traced back from the largest cell until the score drops to 0.
ui.从最底一行最小的格子倒推的缝: the seam walked back from the smallest cell of the bottom row
ui.传感器设置须写成列表。: Sensor picks must be a list.
ui.元件的输入口: an input port of the part
ui.先画好两条路线。在规则面板里切换 A 和 B。: Draw both routes first. Switch between A and B in the side panel.
ui.全部通过后：候选词按步数排: once every test passes: the candidates by number of steps
ui.公共子序列表倒推出的路线和连线: the walk back through a common-subsequence table, and its matched letters
ui.再往上一行：三个虚线框里，哪一格的数 + 当前格子的能量，正好等于当前格子的数？: Up another row: of the three dashed frames, which cell’s number + the current pixel’s energy exactly equals the current cell’s number?
ui.凑零钱：每格是一个钱数，扫描臂退回每种硬币: making change: a cell is an amount, the sweep arm steps back by every coin
ui.切词：一串字母切成词典里的词，每块有代价: cutting a string into dictionary words, each part at a cost
ui.到了，走了 {n} 步。换一个起点。: Made it in {n} steps. On to another start.
ui.剪了 {cuts} 条缝，图片从 {length} 列变成了 {W} 列。: {cuts} seams cut: the picture has gone from {length} columns to {W}.
ui.剪掉了！图片窄了一列。: Cut! The picture is one column narrower.
ui.剪缝只拿掉不起眼的背景，字母原样留着；直接压扁时，每个字母都被挤变形了。: Seam carving removes only unremarkable background and leaves the letters as they were; squashing distorts every letter.
ui.区间表：一段 i..j 的答案，切点扫一遍: the interval table: the answer for a run i..j, every split point swept
ui.千层：同时站在很多层上，探针探到另一层: Layercake: many layers at once, a probe to another
ui.压成一行时，改写方向错了会把一件物品放两次: in one row, rewriting the wrong way packs an item twice
ui.压成一行的背包：只留一行，原地改写: the knapsack in one row, rewritten in place
ui.反例：一家一格时，两段历史落进同一个格子: the counterexample: with one cell a house, two histories land in one cell
ui.只能从路线的最后一格，往右或往下走一格: You can only go one cell right or down from the route’s last cell
ui.只能顺着箭头走。点到「{value}」就记下一条路线；同一条路线只算一次。: You can only follow the arrows. Reaching “{value}” records a route; each route counts only once.
ui.回环：一轮一轮扫到不再变: Loop: scans in rounds until nothing changes
ui.在文本里写 {id}[picks=[…]]() 选它读哪些，读到的每一个是 {i: Write {id}[picks=[…]]() to pick what it reads; each one picked is an output {id}.NAME.
ui.处理「{n}」（{w} kg）时，改 dp[{w2}] 要读 dp[{src}]: While handling the {n} ({w} kg), rewriting dp[{w2}] reads dp[{src}], but dp[{src}] was already rewritten this round and already holds one {n}. So the {n} got packed a second time.
ui.失败时不指出第一处算错的格子: on a failure, do not point at the first cell gone wrong
ui.失败时：第一条 when 成立的说法: on a failure: the first whose when holds
ui.它们在{cell}汇合，一条有钥匙，一条没有。可从这里往右或往下一步都碰不到门，: They meet at {cell}, one with the key and one without. But one step right or down from there never reaches a door, so there is no difference to see yet. Make them meet just left of or above a door.
ui.对齐表：一个词在上面，一个词在左边: an alignment table: one word along the top, one down the left
ui.局部对齐从最大的一格倒推到 0: local alignment walked back from its best cell to a 0
ui.局部对齐：两串字最像的一段: local alignment: the most alike stretch of two strings
ui.已经剪了 {cuts} 条缝，图片现在 {W} 列宽。: {cuts} seam{value} cut so far; the picture is now {W} columns wide.
ui.已选中{value2}的「{value}」，再点另一行里相同的字。: Selected “{value}” in the {value3} row. Now click the same letter in the other row.
ui.手动玩法（在表上点格子），harness 只支持电路关: a hand play (tapping cells on the table); the harness covers circuit levels
ui.扫了 {rounds} 轮，最后一轮一格也没变。: Scanned {rounds} round{value}; the last round changed nothing.
ui.扫帚：扫描臂一次扫过一整段: Broom: a sweep arm over a whole run
ui.找到了！两条路线都停在{value}。路线 {keyed} 带着钥匙，下一步能穿: Found it! Both routes stop at {value}. Route {keyed} carries the key and can go through the door at {value2} next; route {other} is empty-handed and can’t. Yet to a counter that only remembers position, they are the same state.
ui.找反例：画两条路线，落进同一个格子: finding the counterexample: two routes into one cell
ui.把接进来的数加起来。{value}: Adds up the numbers wired into it. {value}
ui.拼电路板：机器人在每一格上跑它: wiring a board the robot runs on every cell
ui.指向{value}的箭头只来自{from}，所以它和{from}一样，是 <b>: The only arrow into {value} comes from {from}, so it is the same as {from}: {value2}. You wrote {mine}.
ui.指向{value}的箭头来自{from}，它们的数是 {value3}，所以应该: The arrows into {value} come from {from}, whose numbers are {value3}, so it should be {value2} = {right}. You wrote {mine}.
ui.按「{value}」依次看 {value2}，装得下就装。结果装了{value3: “{value}” looks at {value2} in that order and packs whatever fits. It packed {value3}, for a value of {v}. {value4}
ui.接进来的「是 / 否」里只要有一个「是」，就输出「是」；否则输出「否」。「—」不: If any of the “yes / no” signals wired into it is “yes”, outputs “yes”; otherwise “no”. A “—” does not count as “yes”.
ui.最近的是 <b>{best}</b>：输入法就会问你「是不是想打 {best}」: The closest is {best}, so your keyboard would ask “Did you mean {best}?”
ui.有钥匙和门的迷宫，状态记住的每组钥匙是一层: a maze of keys and doors, one layer for every set of keys the state remembers
ui.机器人 3×3 的视野：每格的值，亮起的是读的格子: the robot’s 3×3 view: what each cell holds, the ones read lit
ui.机器人一轮一轮地扫整张表，直到一整轮没有格子变化。: The robot scans the whole table round after round until a whole round changes nothing.
ui.机器人写进这一格的数: what the robot writes into the cell
ui.机器人看得见的格子。点一格，就多一个读那一格的输出口；再点一次，输出口就去掉。: The cells the robot sees. Click a cell to add an output that reads it; click it again to remove that output.
ui.机器人脚下这一格的信息。每选一条，就多一个读它的输出口。: Facts about the cell under the robot. Each one you pick adds an output that reads it.
ui.机器算出 {value}，应该是 {value2}。: The machine computed {value}; it should be {value2}.
ui.条件是「是」时，把另一个口收到的信号放过去；否则输出「—」。: When the condition is “yes”, lets through whatever signal reaches the other input; otherwise outputs “—”.
ui.条件是「是」时，输出「—」；否则把另一个口收到的信号原样放过去。: When the condition is “yes”, outputs “—”; otherwise lets whatever signal reaches the other input through unchanged.
ui.板上接了线: a wire is on the board
ui.板上放了元件: a part is on the board
ui.板上有这种元件（可以再说它的数值）: the board has a part of this type (and this value)
ui.格子世界：宝藏、陷阱和墙，扫到不再变: the grid world: treasure, traps and walls, scanned until it settles
ui.棋盘城市，每格存「是 / 否」：能不能走到这里: the grid city holding yes / no: can a route get here
ui.棋盘城市：只往右或往下走，每格可以有石头、体力或金币: the grid city: right or down only, a cell may hold a rock, energy or coins
ui.棋盘：R 行 C 列，箭头往右往下（或按 moves），个别格子另写: a grid of R × C with arrows right and down (or by moves), some cells written apart
ui.正在画路线 {active}。点路线的最后一格可以撤销一步。: Drawing route {active}. Click the route’s last cell to undo a step.
ui.正在看{where}，再点一次取消。: Looking at {where}. Click again to leave.
ui.每一格的数，是站在这里有多好：离宝藏越近越大，每远一步打个九折。机器人每一步都走: Each cell’s number says how good it is to stand there: the closer to the treasure, the bigger, with 10% knocked off for every step further away. At every step the robot moves to the neighbour with the biggest number.
ui.每一格都长出了一根箭头：指向四个邻居里价值最大的那一格。从任何一格出发，顺着箭头: Every cell has grown an arrow pointing to its neighbour with the largest value. Start from any cell, follow the arrows, and you reach the treasure.
ui.每个字最多连一根线。先点它，拆掉原来的线: Each letter takes at most one line. Click it first to remove its line
ui.每个测试的正确答案，按测试的顺序（没有答案写 null）: each test’s right answer, in the tests’ order (null where there is none)
ui.每件可以拿很多次: as many times as you like
ui.没有从「{value}」通往「{value2}」的单行道: There is no one-way street from “{value}” to “{value2}”
ui.没有钥匙，过不了这扇门: Without the key you can’t get through this door
ui.测试 {k} 中，机器扫了 {MAX_ROUNDS} 轮，表还在变。照这块电路板: In test {k}, the machine scanned {MAX_ROUNDS} rounds and the table was still changing. With this circuit board, some cells keep growing (or shrinking) and will never settle down.
ui.测试 {k} 中，机器算到<b>{value}</b>时，电路要读<b>{val: In test {k}, when the machine reached {value}, the circuit tried to read {value2}, but that cell was still empty. The machine works in the order “{value3}”, so a cell must already be computed before anything reads it.
ui.点一块，在这里改它：输入、常数，或汇合器的操作。点棋盘上的格子换机器人的位置。: Tap a block to change it here: an input, a constant or a merger’s operation. Tap a cell on the board to move the robot.
ui.点测试棋盘上的格子，让机器人站过去；输入元件读的就是棋盘上的格子，改它就是改那一: Click a cell on the test board to send the robot there; an input part reads a cell of the board, so changing it changes that cell. Then run, and the answer goes into the red frame.
ui.物品一览，正在改写的那件亮起: the items, the one being rewritten lit
ui.玩这一关电路任务的机器人: the robot the level’s circuit tasks are played by
ui.环形的街：第一家和最后一家相邻: a street in a ring: the first house and the last are neighbours
ui.用所选模式把几个输入合并成一个值。: Combines the inputs into one value using the selected play.
ui.留下接进来的数里最大的那个。{value}: Keeps the largest of the numbers wired into it. {value}
ui.留下接进来的数里最小的那个。{value}: Keeps the smallest of the numbers wired into it. {value}
ui.看第 1 条街的前两家。下面两段历史走到 2 号时，在一行的机器里落进<b>同一: Look at the first two houses of street 1. When the two histories reach house 2, a one-row machine puts them in the same cell:
ui.砖块叠成的三角：从顶上一块往下走: bricks stacked in a triangle, walked down from the top one
ui.第 n 条来路（a、b、c、d）：一个传感器，或板上一个只属于这一关的输入: way in n (a, b, c, d): a sensor, or an input of the board of its own
ui.第 {ti} 题完成，达到了目标价值: Puzzle {ti} done: you reached the target value
ui.第一个任务从这一关玩家留下的电路板开始（必须是先修）: the first task starts from the board left on this level (a prerequisite)
ui.第一条缝你来找：从最底一行最小的格子出发，每次看它是从上面哪一格走来的，一行一行: You find the first seam: start from the smallest cell in the bottom row, see each time which cell above it came from, and trace back up row by row.
ui.第一次打开这个任务时说的一句: a line said the first time the task opens
ui.红框是填错的格子。先看第一个：{value}: The red frames mark the wrong cells. Look at the first one: {value}
ui.给句子标词性：每一列一个词，每一行一种词性: tagging a sentence: a word a column, a part of speech a row
ui.维特比表倒推出的词性: the tags walked back through a Viterbi table
ui.编辑距离表倒推出的路线: the walk back through an edit-distance table
ui.股价：每天三种状态，空手、持有、刚卖掉: share prices: three states a day, flat, holding, just sold
ui.背包表倒推出的装法: the packing walked back through a knapsack table
ui.背包表：行是物品，列是容量: the knapsack table: rows are items, columns capacities
ui.背包装了 {used} 千克，上限 {W} 千克: The backpack holds {used} kg of {W} kg
ui.自己起名字的口: a port with a name of its own
ui.表倒推出的标法 · 代价 {cost}: Tagging traced back from the table · cost {cost}
ui.表格倒推出的改法 · {n} 步: The edits traced back from the table · {n} step{value}
ui.表格里藏着的连线: The lines hidden in the table
ui.装不下：{value}重 {w} kg，背包只剩 {left} kg: It won’t fit: {value} ({w} kg), with only {left} kg of room left
ui.规则你已经会了：后面的缝交给机器去找、去剪。: You know the rule now: leave the machine to find and cut the remaining seams.
ui.让机器人站到这一格: Put the robot on this cell
ui.词典（和每个词的代价）: the dictionary (and what each word costs)
ui.读这一关的一个传感器，名字随它: a sensor of the level, named as it is
ui.起点 {k} / {length}：点一个虚线框的邻居，让机器人走过去。: Start {k} / {length}: click a neighbour in a dashed frame to move the robot there.
ui.起点已经填好了：到这里的路线算 1 条: The start is already filled in: it counts as 1 route
ui.起点算 <b>1</b>。选中一个{value}后，它的「上一站」会亮起黄色虚框: The start counts as 1. When you select a {value}, its “previous stops” get a dashed yellow frame and the arrows into it turn yellow.
ui.路线要从「{value}」出发: A route has to start at “{value}”
ui.路线要从左上角的起点出发: A route has to start from the top-left corner
ui.输入元件上点了这个传感器: an input card reads this sensor
ui.输出 a + b。只要有一边是「—」，结果就是「—」。: Outputs a + b. If either side is “—”, so is the result.
ui.输出 a × b。只要有一边是「—」，结果就是「—」。: Outputs a × b. If either side is “—”, so is the result.
ui.输出口「{value}」还没接线: The output “{value}” is not wired yet
ui.过河的青蛙：每块石头写着往回能跳多远: a frog crossing a river: each stone says how far back a jump reaches
ui.这一关搭出一个元件：板只能读元件的这些口。: This level builds a part: the board may read only its ports.
ui.这一格是 <b>{v}</b>，最底一行最小的是 <b>{min}</b>。缝要: This cell is {v}, but the smallest in the bottom row is {min}. The less energy a seam costs, the better.
ui.这一题每种东西可以拿很多件。从右往左改写时，dp[w − 重量] 总是旧值，每种: In this test, each kind of thing can be taken many times. Rewriting from right to left, dp[w − weight] is always an old value, so each thing gets taken only once.
ui.这两个口的信号对不上。: The signals at these two ends do not match.
ui.这个任务的失败是要讲的道理：说完进下一个任务: failing this task is its lesson: then on to the next
ui.这个任务问什么（写在一关的说明下面）: what this task asks (under the level’s brief)
ui.这个传感器读了，还接出了线: this sensor is read and wired on
ui.这个口只接「是 / 否」信号，比如「是起点」。: This input only takes a “yes / no” signal, such as “is start”.
ui.这块板给出的口：parts.json 里引用这个任务的件是一个元件，口就是这些: the ports this board gives: the parts.json part referring to this task is a part, and these are its ports
ui.这块电路板要做成元件，元件的每个口都要接进电路；还没接的：{value}。: This board becomes a part, so every port of the part must be wired in; not yet: {value}.
ui.这块电路板要做成元件，它的输入只能是元件的口；它还读了：{value}。: This board becomes a part, so it may read only the part’s ports; it also reads: {value}.
ui.这条缝找到了，图片上标红的就是它。点「剪掉」。: Seam found: it is the one marked in red on the picture. Click “Cut it”.
ui.远望：视野 5×5，看得见表头，会换方向扫: Farsight: a 5×5 view, the table’s headings, other scan orders
ui.连上的字从左往右读，就是两串字共有的一串。: Read left to right, the linked letters are a sequence the two strings share.
ui.连线不交叉：两串字相同的字母连起来: lines that never cross between equal letters of two strings
ui.逐列，从右下往上: column by column, from the bottom right upwards
ui.逐列，从右往左: column by column, right to left
ui.逐列，从左往右: column by column, left to right
ui.逐格判对错，不只看答案: grade every cell, not just the answer
ui.逐行，从右下开始: row by row, from the bottom right
ui.逐行，从左上开始: row by row, from the top left
ui.通过后、进下一个任务之前说的话: what passing it says, before the next task
ui.通过后：倒推出的改法: once passed: the edits traced back
ui.通过后：倒推出的标法（测试有 note 时加一句）: once passed: the tagging traced back (and the test’s note)
ui.通过后：倒推出的装法: once passed: the packing traced back
ui.通过后：最像的一段: once passed: the most alike stretch
ui.通过后：表格里藏着的连线: once passed: the lines hidden in the table
ui.铺草坪：一块地上有树，找最大的空正方形: a lawn to lay: a field with trees, the biggest open square
ui.长臂：视野 5×5，伸缩臂够到任意远: Longarm: a 5×5 view, a telescopic arm
ui.顺着价值画出箭头: drawing the arrows along the values

capability.robot.items.robot-scout.name: Boxy
capability.robot.items.robot-scout.desc: Vision 3×3: it sees the ring of 8 cells around it.
capability.robot.items.robot-ranger.name: Farsight
capability.robot.items.robot-ranger.desc: Vision upgraded to 5×5, two rings around it, 24 cells; it also sees the two words along a table’s edges, and it can scan another way: backwards, or by length.
capability.robot.items.robot-reach.name: Longarm
capability.robot.items.robot-reach.desc: Vision 5×5, plus a telescopic arm: it reaches back by as many cells as this cell says, and reads cells outside its view.
capability.robot.items.robot-broom.name: Broom
capability.robot.items.robot-broom.desc: Vision 3×3, plus a sweep arm: it sweeps a whole run of cells in one go and feeds every number in the run into the circuit board, however many cells the run has.
capability.robot.items.robot-loop.name: Loop
capability.robot.items.robot-loop.desc: Vision 3×3, and it scans in rounds: a cell not worked out yet reads its value from the last round, and it stops once a whole round changes nothing.
capability.robot.items.robot-stack.name: Layercake
capability.robot.items.robot-stack.desc: It stands on many layers at once: however many layers the table has, it works once on the same cell of each. Every layer has a 3×3 view, and its probe reaches cells on another layer.

capability.world.studio.label: Worlds
